name: Maximum Subsequence
description: You are given an array a consisting of n integers, and additionally an integer m . You have to choose some sequence of indices b 1 , b 2 , ..., b k ( 1 ≤ b 1 < b 2 < ... < b k ≤ n ) in such a way that the value of is maximized. Chosen sequence can be empty. Print the maximum possible value of .
input_specification: The first line contains two integers n and m ( 1 ≤ n ≤ 35 , 1 ≤ m ≤ 10 9 ). The second line contains n integers a 1 , a 2 , ..., a n ( 1 ≤ a i ≤ 10 9 ).
output_specification: Print the maximum possible value of .
approach_summary: Split N-element search space into two halves of size N/2. Compute states for each half in O(2^(N/2)) and combine via sorting / two pointers / hash map.
